title: App tile on a phone
slide_intent: Test recognition among neighboring brands because an app icon competes for a small and crowded space.
strategic_value: The black 4 on bright green can distinguish Channel 4 in a familiar phone interface.
demonstration: A close-up phone screen places the Channel 4 tile beside Instagram and above TikTok, with programme artwork below.
practical_value: Evaluate the mark and color at app-tile scale rather than as a large isolated logo.

content_islands.name: App neighborhood
content_islands.spec: Place the Channel 4 tile among neighboring applications at the upper portion of the phone.

content_islands.name: Device context
content_islands.spec: Retain the bezel, background and partial content widget to establish real scale.

reference_purposes.Application: The mark and green field are applied to a mobile app tile.
